svg.font-family: 'Source Sans Pro', 'Helvetica Neue', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: Who has de facto control over data in the United States, China, and the European Union
svg.desc: A diagram that asks who has de facto control over data, in three rows. United States: firms, shown with the logos of Google, Meta, and Amazon, because no federal law commits to data privacy. China: the government, because the state is the final arbiter of data rights. European Union: citizens, because the law privileges their data privacy.
svg.text: WHO HAS DE FACTO CONTROL OVER DATA?
No federal law commits to data privacy
The state is the final arbiter of data rights
The law privileges their data privacy
